primitives.name: CommonReferenceDomain
primitives.statement: Both finite projected maps use the same five-value input alphabet {-1,-1/2,0,1/2,1}.
primitives.operational_definition: Compare N=8->4 and N=4->2 on identical input field values and projected coupling coordinates.

primitives.name: RescalingCourt
primitives.statement: Four declared field normalizations compete by cross-size projected-map discrepancy.

primitives.name: AutonomyGate
primitives.statement: A finite rescaled RG map is admitted as locally autonomous only if map, Jacobian, and finite-difference gates all pass.

definitions.name: FieldScaleCouplingTransform
definitions.statement: Under z=a*y, kappa and m2 scale as a^-2 while lambda scales as a^-4.

definitions.name: CrossScaleMapResidual
definitions.statement: Relative L2 discrepancy between N=8 and N=4 projected maps at the same reference coupling.

definitions.name: CrossScaleJacobianResidual
definitions.statement: Relative Frobenius discrepancy between the refined N=8 and N=4 local projected-map Jacobians.

claims.statement: The declared field coordinate rescaling transforms projected couplings as kappa->kappa/a^2, m2->m2/a^2, lambda->lambda/a^4.
BOLTZMANN_M2_MATCH minimizes the tested cross-size map residual and passes the declared 0.05 map-level gate at the R15 reference point.
The winning-scheme Jacobians are stable under halving the finite-difference step within the declared tolerance.
The winning normalization fails the declared Jacobian-autonomy gate despite passing the map-level gate.
Fixed-point search remains inadmissible because the complete finite autonomy gate fails.
Adding symmetry-compatible effective operators can reduce cross-size Jacobian mismatch enough to pass a future autonomy gate.

metadata.purpose: Test whether explicit field rescaling is sufficient to make the finite projected RG locally autonomous across sizes.
